full_judgment: 16. From the above rule, it appears that water tanks used by public cannot be leased out. In the case in hand, we find that in violation of the above rule, the land of plot No. 794 was leased out to the plaintiff. It is, however, contended that in the remarks column of C.S. record through mistake it was written “সর্ব সাধারণের ব্যবহারয”. In this connection, it is important to note here that according to section 103 B (5) of the Bengal Tenancy Act, every entry made in a record-of-rights shall be presumed to be correct until it is proved by evidence to be incorrect. The plaintiff, how-ever, could not rebut the presumption of correctness of the entry made in the C.S. khatian including the entry made in its remarks column in which it was written “সর্ব সাধারণের ব্যবহারয”.
